requirements.quote: A clerk can complete onboarding on mobile in Tamil or Kannada and the senior approves with one tap. [type:e2e]
requirements.evidence: CI Playwright e2e job (ship PRs and nightly) runs e2e/tests/workspaces/clerk-onboarding.spec.ts; component and action tests run in lane

requirements.quote: Clerk permissions are unchanged (no strategy notes). [type:integration]
The senior gets a one-tap approval of the clerk's setup.
The UI is localised Tamil and Kannada first and mobile-first.
the clerk can import, confirm listings and run the court-day view; strategy notes stay hidden (existing rule).
The clerk is invited by the senior, or the clerk starts and invites the senior to confirm.
requirements.why: The senior-invites-clerk path is delivered. A clerk-started workspace would have no owner, and the clerk must not get owner, so this needs a product decision on ownerless or draft workspaces.
